note: Per category, install the top `keepSharePerCategory` share of curated skills, ranked by the selection score from scripts/install_scores.py (capacity + behavioural/quality evidence). `keepMinScore` is an absolute floor: anything scoring at or above it is installed no matter how crowded the category is. A behavioural PASS is always installed. 0 for keepSharePerCategory = install everything. `topBandsPerCategory` is the LEGACY absolute-band rule and is only used when keepSharePerCategory is absent. Regenerate scripts/install-manifest.txt after changing this file.
hostProjectedNote: Stores whose views are created by the HOST, not by this vault. Cindy re-projects ~/.agents/skills into ~/.claude/skills on every start; sync must not lift those junctions, or the harness loses ~200 skills until the next app restart (SKILL_CANDIDATES.md #81).
